name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Mid-Market Account Executive | MarTech & Data SaaS, Full-Cycle Value Selling
summary: Full-cycle SaaS account executive with 15+ years in MarTech, SaaS, and agency sales. Ranked top three on a team of 8 to 15 at Accelo while quota roughly doubled, averaging ~$213K a year in services bookings plus recurring revenue, and closed $130K+ in new business at Fetch & Funnel. I also build what marketers buy: lifecycle automation, CRM architecture, SQL on BigQuery and GA4 data, and AI agent workflows. That means discovery with a marketing or data team starts from their real stack, not a script. Denver-based.
